text:
Samir Khan: heads-up: Sapphire Retail (acct ..9077) had mixed results on today's autopay. card charged for SR-210 ($3,200) but declines for SR-211 and SR-212 (~$9,400).
Zoe Kim: decline codes? was it a soft decline or a bank block?
billing-bot: alert: payment_attempts: SR-210=approved card_last4=9077 SR-211=declined code=insufficient_funds SR-212=declined code=do_not_honor attempts=1
CS-Tom: i spoke with their AP. they can pay SR-211 via card if limit increased, but SR-212 they'll wire. requesting wire instructions and a remittance template.
Samir Khan: ok do one immediate retry for SR-211 only if AP confirms new limit; do NOT retry SR-212 by card. pause dunning for 48h while CS coordinates. tag account=high_touch.
AR-Linda: note: when they split payment, we must reconcile partial card then wire remainder; ask client to include invoice numbers and amounts in remittance. also require remittance email for AR.
CS-Tom: sent customer split-pay options and minimal wire template (no full acct in slack):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
SWIFT/IBAN: [please confirm]
Reference: Sapphire Retail + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX
```
CS-Tom: they replied: "we will increase card limit for SR-211 (processing now) and wire remainder for SR-212. sending bank_receipt.pdf when wire initiated."
billing-bot: action logged: scheduled_retry=SR-211 at=1780001300; auto_retry_result=pending
Samir Khan: good. AR-Linda please prepare reconciliation note: apply card payment to SR-210 then SR-211 when clears; apply incoming wire to SR-212. if wire covers more than SR-212, apply to oldest unpaid.
AR-Linda: noted. creating AR ticket AR-6112 and attaching reconciliation checklist. tag=pending_wire tag=sapphire
Payments-Bot: please upload any bank receipts to the secure upload portal: https://secure.redwood.ai/upload (do not paste bank PDFs in slack).
CS-Tom: customer uploaded bank_receipt.pdf to secure portal and pasted confirmation id in ticket AR-6112. they expect settlement 24-48h.
Zoe Kim: because outstanding > $10k (current ~12,600) and split payment promised, do not trigger service hold. require VP approval for temporary credit >$5k if they ask.
Samir Khan: add fallback: if wire not received in 72h, escalate to AR lead and open churn-risk review. set reminder check in 72h.
billing-bot: reminder scheduled: check_ticket=AR-6112 remind_at=1780060000
AR-Linda: added CRM note: decline_reasons=[insufficient_funds, do_not_honor]; reduce auto-retry count for Sapphire to 1 attempt for next 30 days.
CS-Tom: client asked whether we can accept split card+ACH instead of wire. i sent ACH link: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup and asked them to confirm preferred method.
Samir Khan: thanks. once remittance lands, attach proof to AR-6112, reconcile, and close ticket. keep thread open until funds clear. :thumbsup:
